We go beyond software; we become our clients’ growth partners by leveraging technology, strategy, and hands-on execution.

About the role

We’re hiring an Account Strategist to help scale our Growth Agency. This is not your typical account management role — We’re looking for someone who thinks beyond playbooks - someone who is deeply curious, driven by first-principles thinking, and excited to help define what modern service delivery looks like in the age of AI.

You’ll be the connective tissue between our clients, internal teams, and evolving product offerings — helping clients succeed while shaping how we scale service delivery.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor , helping clients get the most out of our services and platform.

  • Identify upsell and expansion opportunities , and partner with sales to drive growth. You’ll also flag any account risks early, and proactively address concerns before they become blockers.

  • Communicate with clarity and confidence in both internal and external settings.

  • Stay curious and informed about new tools, trends, and use cases in AI and automation - and bring those insights to our team and clients.

Bonus points if…

  • You’ve worked in a high-touch agency or consulting environment.

  • You’re familiar with B2B SaaS or technical service delivery.

  • You’ve built processes or systems to improve client engagement and retention.

  • You’ve spent countless hours with tools like Claude & ChatGPT.

Collaborative Culture

  • Open communication & feedback-driven environment.

title: Tech Lead SRE Remoto
description:
O isaac é a maior plataforma de soluções financeiras feita para escolas. Impulsionamos as instituições oferecendo receita garantida e proporcionando mais flexibilidade de pagamento para as famílias.

Nosso objetivo é facilitar a gestão financeira, acabando com a dor de cabeça e permitindo que a escola consiga focar na missão de educar , dedicando mais tempo e recursos para tirar os planos do papel.

Nos últimos 4 anos, já ajudamos mais de2.000 escolas, garantimos mais de R$5bi em mensalidades garantidas, e ajudamos a aumentar em 9% o número de matrículas em nossas escolas parceiras.

A cultura do isaac incentiva a autonomia, a mão na massa, o trabalho em equipe e o uso de dados para construir soluções inovadoras.

Temos muito para construir e transformar na Educação brasileira, e você pode fazer parte dessa revolução, vivenciando o impacto do seu trabalho na sociedade!

Vem com a gente?

No isaac, operamos com um time enxuto de Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) que lidera nossa estratégia de Platform Engineering , priorizando a autonomia das equipes de desenvolvimento. Estamos focados em alavancar a produtividade das pessoas e a resiliência dos serviços, apoiando dezenas de pessoas desenvolvedoras, engenheiras de dados e cientistas de dados.

O time de SRE é fundamental para nosso sucesso. Para fortalecer nosso time, estamos em busca de uma pessoa SRE Tech Lead com expertise em automação de processos de infraestrutura e engenharia, com foco em Platform Engineering e Developer Experience.

No isaac, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Fazer a diferença real: Você terá um impacto direto na produtividade e na autonomia das equipes de desenvolvimento, ajudando-as a criar e manter produtos e serviços excepcionais.
  • Trabalhar com tecnologias de ponta: Você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com as mais recentes tecnologias em nuvem, como Kubernetes, GCP, Helm, Datadog, Terraform, Humanitec e Cast AI
  • Aprender e crescer: Você estará em um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo, cercado por pessoas talentosas e apaixonadas pelo que fazem.
  • Fazer parte de uma equipe incrível: Você se juntará a uma equipe pequena, mas de alto desempenho, de SREs experientes e apaixonados pelo seu trabalho.

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas do time de SRE
  • Criar abstrações e prover serviços de infraestrutura em nuvem que ajudem os times a reduzir a carga cognitiva e a fricção na criação e manutenção de produtos e serviços, aumentando sua autonomia e diminuindo o toil.
  • Avançar nossa plataforma Cloud com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) usando Terraform e Kubernetes como base.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar os componentes usados pelas equipes em seus pipelines de Continuous Integration.
  • Administrar clusters Kubernetes rodando em GKE.
  • Colaborar com os times de desenvolvimento para definir a arquitetura por meio de RFCs.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de engenharia para desenvolver soluções em conjunto.
  • Diagnosticar problemas de arquitetura e em serviços mantidos pela equipe de SRE.
  • Contribuir na definição de estratégias de monitoramento e observabilidade dos sistemas, SLIs e SLOs.
  • Gerenciar incidentes de infraestrutura e prestar suporte às equipes de engenharia durante incidentes em suas aplicações.

Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Experiência consolidada como SRE, DevOps, Production Engineer ou Platform Engineer.
  • Proficiência em tecnologias de nuvem, preferencialmente GCP.
  • Experiência sólida em Terraform.
  • Ampla experiência em Kubernetes (GKE é um diferencial).
  • Habilidade em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (preferencialmente Go ou Python).
  • Conhecimento sólido em redes e protocolos, armazenamento, computação e CDN.
  • Compreensão dos princípios de segurança de aplicações e ambientes em nuvem.
  • Experiência em observabilidade.
  • Experiência em administração de sistemas Linux e bancos de dados (PostgreSQL e Redis).
  • Experiência em criação de pipelines de Integração Contínua/Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua (CI/CD).
  • Experiência em monitoramento, observabilidade e registro de infraestrutura e serviços (Conhecimento de Datadog é um diferencial).
  • Auxílio alimentação e/ou refeição (Flash flexível - R$40,50/dia);
  • Auxílio home office no primeiro mês de trabalho (R$200,00);
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico Sulamérica sem mensalidade e com coparticipação;
  • Licença maternidade (180 dias) e paternidade (30 dias) estendida;
  • Auxílio creche para mamães e papais com filhos até 06 anos;
  • Cuidado com a saúde física para você e seus dependentes: parceria com a Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Incentivo à educação - parcerias com diversas instituições de ensino;
  • ArcoLab - plataforma de educação corporativa;
  • Desconto em passagens aéreas e hospedagens;
  • Reembolso para evolução profissonal (cursos, palestras, eventos, etc);
  • Férias flexíveis (antecipação de 15 dias de férias após 6 meses).

#MaisDiversidade

Acreditamos que em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo nossas pessoas serão mais felizes, engajadas e com mais chances de atingir o seu máximo potencial . Por isso, aqui na isaac - uma empresa do Grupo Arco Educação, respeitamos e valorizamos a igualdade de direito, reconhecemos as singularidades e acreditamos que todas as pessoas podem contribuir para o nosso propósito. #vempraisaac

title: Accounts Payable Specialist
description:
Working At Bitso

We are a diverse team that takes pride in understanding the perspectives of others. We fully embrace working remotely and we are eager to act, improve and accelerate progress inside and outside of our organization.

To drive revolutionary changes in society and make crypto useful, we delight our customers with world-class products, deep care, and intentional empathy.

Your Purpose

The Accounts Payable Specialist, who will be part of the Finance division, will be responsible for the administration and recording of expenses (overhead, employee expenses, reimbursements, and credit card reconciliation) as well as the administration of supplier master data.

Reports To

Accounts Payable Lead

Who You Are

  • At least 3 years of experience in accounts payable in Brazil.
  • Proven expertise in processing and performing the accounting registration for local payment methods, including Boleto Bancário and PIX.
  • Experience with other Latin American countries is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian tax requirements applicable to bill payments, including knowledge of withholding taxes (e.g., IRRF, PIS/COFINS, ISS).
  • Experience with NetSuite and/or other ERP systems.
  • Degree in Accounting, Business Management, or a related field.
  • Strong aptitude for numbers and computations.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy is a must.
  • Organized and proactive, with the ability to take initiative and prioritize tasks effectively.
  • An agile and efficient work ethic with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, in both verbal and written form (English).
  • A strong sense of responsibility and commitment to the company's core values.
  • Service-oriented attitude.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial information.

What You Will Do

  • Ensure all accounts payable policies and procedures are adhered to including travel and related expenses, mainly in Brazil and Latin American entities.
  • Improve and continue accounts payable policies.
  • Maintain accounts payable files.
  • Review of tax requirements.
  • Weekly payments schedule.
  • Prepares journal entries; maintains and reconciles ledger accounts.
  • Ensure all reporting is completed accurately and timely, including month-end closing, audits, and other requests.
  • Maintaining constant and strong communication with the treasury and planning teams to ensure the veracity of accounting and financial information.
  • Working hand in hand with the company’s Treasurer to report weekly and monthly the expenses detailed by the cost center and tribes.
  • Reconciliation and integration of accounts payable balances (by name and age).
  • Credit card reconciliation (by name and age).
  • Assist with audits by providing supporting records and documentation.

Research in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion suggests that individuals may hesitate to apply for jobs if they do not meet all the listed criteria. At Bitso, we value diversity and your unique strengths could be just what we're looking for. If this role excites you but you don't match every point in the description, we still want to hear from you.

Who We Are

With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we’re committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products.

When we hire people for our team, we specifically test for the following traits in addition to our cultural values:

  • Mission-Driven : We seek individuals who are passionate about crypto and Bitso’s mission and resilient in facing industry challenges
  • High Sense of Urgency : We prioritize candidates who demonstrate a high sense of urgency and responsibility.
  • Exceptional Hard Skills : We seek individuals who possess exceptional skills in their respective fields, with no room for mediocrity.
  • Self-Management : We look for individuals who can independently manage their work, career, and professional development.

Compensation & Benefits

At Bitso, you are taking the front seat on the edge of crypto innovation, creating the next generation of crypto-powered products.

So for those willing to commit, adapt and pioneer the most important change of the century we offer:

  • Me Time program, including unlimited paid time off.
  • Remote-first work environment.
  • Employee Stock Option program.
  • Zero trading fees through our Bitso Alpha app.
  • Extended Family Leave Policy: all birthing parents, non-birthing parents and adopting parents are eligible for a 4-month leave.
  • Premium health, dental and life insurances in Mexico, Gibraltar, Colombia, USA, Brazil and Argentina.
  • Monthly stipend for gym memberships, relaxation activities, sports equipment, cooking classes, books, entertainment and more.

Want to leave an undoubtedly legacy with us? Fasten your seatbelt and join this spaceship, where you will find exponential growth and the opportunity to thrive!

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)

title: Finance Data Analyst (100% remote-friendly within Brazil)
description:
Company Description

About Us

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.
Learn more about our products here:pro.doctoralia.es

Why Join Us?

  • Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.
  • At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.
  • Pre-IPO & growing – We’re backed by leading VC funds including One Peak Partners, Goldman Sachs Asset Management, and Point Nine Capital, raising a total of approx. €400m to date. Now, we’re focused on profitability and IPO preparation. It’s an exciting time to join us.
  • Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long-termsuccess.
Job Description

The new team member, working within the Financial Reporting team, will play a key role in supporting the evolution of financial reporting in a challenging and stimulating environment. You will help bridge the gap between finance and BI. Our primary objective is to assist the business in making decisions based on data, with a particular emphasis on producing reports as the primary and most reliable source of information.

A team of 12 experts provides support to various departments, including marketing, sales, customer success, finance, and people experience, for both short-term and long-term projects. Collaborating closely with stakeholders, we strive to develop reports, analyses, models, and recommendations that enable us to gain a deep understanding of how we can enhance the satisfaction of both doctors and patients.

You will be an integral part of the Financial Reporting team, working closely with the Data Analytics team to support business decisions based on data.
How would you be impacting our mission

  • Financial Reporting and Analysis: Track key financial metrics and KPIs, ensuring they align with organizational goals;Develop and maintain comprehensive financial dashboards using advanced BI tools;Provide detailed insights into financial performance, trends, and variances;Provide insights for long-term strategic decisions;
  • Data Management and Integration :Ensure accurate and timely collection of financial data from systems like Oracle NetSuite;Integrate data from multiple sources for a unified financial view;
  • Performance Measurement: Analyze profitability and cost efficiency to identify improvement areas;
  • Regulatory and Compliance Reporting :Support audits and for regulatory documentation;
  • Automation and Process Improvement: Automate repetitive financial tasks to improve efficiency;Implement process improvements to reduce manual efforts and errors;
  • Enhanced Reporting and Visualization: Utilize BI tools like Tableau for dynamic, interactive reports and dashboards;Enhance report quality and accessibility beyond traditional spreadsheets.
Qualifications

What will help you thrive?

  • Bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Econometrics or a related field.
  • Demonstrable experience in using SQL to derive actionable insights, either in commercial or academic setting (must have).
  • Knowledge of Python/R and desire to expand your knowledge.
  • Experience with statistical modeling and descriptive statistics.
  • Experience in partnership with internal stakeholders.
  • Experience in leading and executing end to end BI projects.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills in English; proficiency in other languages such as German, Spanish, and Italian is a plus.
  • Ability to gather, organize, analyze, and report large volumes of financial data with speed and accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to provide high-quality work efficiently.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to adapt and work in a quickly changing environment, managing competing demands.

Which skills are ‘bonus points’?

  • Master's degree in Economics, Statistics, Econometrics or a related field.
  • Able to take a step back from the technicalities and examine them through a business lens.
  • Open to cooperating with a lot of people from many teams in different countries.
  • Like to see the instant effects of your work.
  • Knowledge of ERP finance applications (Oracle, Oracle - NetSuite, SAP).
  • Relevant experience in accounting and financial reporting.
Additional Information

What to Expect from Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Acquisition Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper dive into your experience and aspirations with your future manager, who you’ll be reporting to in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

Second Hiring Manager Interview

Business Case Presentation & Team Meeting

Why You’ll Love It Here

Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

  • Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.

  • Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.

  • Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

  • ESOP (Employee ShareOwnership Plan) after 6 months with us—because we believe in sharing our success!

Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.


What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out ourGlassdoor to hear what our people say!

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

Overview

Join to apply for the Inbound Sales Representative role at Toptal .

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

Our Inbound Sales Representatives connect and engage with prospective clients who originate from inbound leads. They seek new business opportunities by connecting with, and developing relationships with, potential customers and guiding prospective clients throughout the required sales stages. To excel in this position, you need to effectively communicate and collaborate with clients, ensuring they understand the value of our services and how Toptal can support their goals. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, is hungry to exceed sales quotas, and strives to go above and beyond. If you are passionate about sales, innately driven, and results-oriented, this is the perfect opportunity for you to launch your sales career.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

  • Sales Cycle Management: You will be the initial face of Toptal and support our clients through the required sales stages. As the first point of contact and the initial ‘face’ of Toptal for new clients, you will be responsible for moving these clients forward in the sales process, starting with regularly conducting sales calls. You will be responsible for accurately articulating the benefit of Toptal to potential clients in these calls and managing deal cycles from discovery through close.
  • Client Experience: You will execute a customer-centric approach across all client interactions during pre-defined working hours. You will build rapport with prospective clients, which will require researching clients before outreach and staying on top of industry trends and Toptal competitors.
  • Collaboration with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team to promptly respond to high-volume inbound client inquiries. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB sales team members always look to improve individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical to achieving success in this role at Toptal.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • The ideal candidate has 1-3 years of B2B sales experience (e.g., Account Executive, Inside Sales, Outside Sales Representative, Account Representative, or related title).
  • Software or tech-related sales experience and education are a plus.
  • Be attentive to client needs. You will be required to be fully available during your working hours to take client calls.
  • You are client-centric. You will be working with prospective clients daily, uncovering and resolving clients’ issues through value-based selling.
  • Have a “will-to-win” attitude. You’re looking to not only meet but exceed your quota and are naturally competitive. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission and want our Client Advisors to make the most out of it!
  • You’re a “learn-it-all.” We are looking for someone who is always looking to grow, strives for improvement, and constantly seeks feedback from peers/leaders. Even as an individual contributor, you seek to share and gain knowledge from those around you.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with your team members.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. We move quickly, so having exceptional time management skills and the ability to manage a high volume of clients is key to being successful in this role.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Overview

RYZ is seeking a Sr. Data Analyst with expert SQL skills and deep expertise in product analytics to drive data-driven decision making across our product organization. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills combined with business acumen to translate complex data into actionable product insights.

  • Product Analytics: Analyze user behavior, feature adoption, product performance metrics, and user engagement patterns
  • A/B Testing: Design, implement, and analyze product experiments and A/B tests to optimize user experience and product features
  • Retention Analysis: Build and maintain customer retention models, cohort analysis, and churn prediction models
  • Customer Lifecycle: Analyze customer journey, lifecycle stages, conversion funnel optimization, and user segmentation
  • Advanced SQL Analysis: Perform complex data analysis using advanced SQL techniques for product insights
  • Dashboard Development: Create and maintain product analytics dashboards and automated reports
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with product, engineering, marketing, and customer experience teams

Required Qualifications

  • 5-7 years of data analysis experience with focus on product analytics and user behavior
  • Expert SQL Skills: Advanced SQL proficiency including complex joins, window functions, CTEs, and query optimization
  • A/B Testing Expertise: Strong background in experimental design, statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and A/B testing platforms
  • Product Analytics: Deep experience with product analytics platforms (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Google Analytics) and product metrics
  • Statistical Analysis: Solid understanding of statistical significance, confidence intervals, power analysis, and experimental design
  • Data Visualization: Proficiency with creating clear, actionable dashboards and reports using BI tools
  • User Behavior Analysis: Experience analyzing user journeys, conversion funnels, and behavioral patterns
  • Business Intelligence: Experience with Looker, Tableau, or similar BI platforms (Omni experience a plus)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Programming Skills: Python or R for advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and automation
  • Digital Product Experience: Background in consumer-facing digital products, e-commerce, or marketplace businesses
  • Customer Experience: Understanding of customer journey mapping, CX metrics, and user experience analytics
  • Advanced Analytics: Experience with machine learning models for user behavior prediction and segmentation

RYZ Labs is a startup studio built in 2021 by two lifelong entrepreneurs. The founders of RYZ have worked at some of the world's largest tech companies and some of the most iconic consumer brands. They have lived and worked in Argentina for many years and have decades of experience in Latam. What brought them together is the passion for the early phases of company creation and the idea of attracting the brightest talents to build industry-defining companies in a post-pandemic world.

Our teams are remote and distributed throughout the US and Latam. They use the latest cutting-edge technologies in cloud computing to create applications that are scalable and resilient. We aim to provide diverse product solutions for different industries, planning to build a large number of startups in the upcoming years.

At RYZ, you will find yourself working with autonomy and efficiency, owning every step of your development. We provide an environment of opportunities, learning, growth, expansion, and challenging projects. You will deepen your experience while sharing and learning from a team of great professionals and specialists.

Values

  • Customer First Mentality - every decision we make should be made through the lens of the customer
  • Bias for Action - urgency is critical, expect that the timeline to get something done is accelerated
  • Ownership - step up if you see an opportunity to help, even if not your core responsibility. Humility and Respect - be willing to learn, be vulnerable, and treat everyone who interacts with RYZ with respect
  • Frugality - being frugal and cost-conscious helps us do more with less

title: Product Designer (Full-Time, SaaS Platform)
description:
Product Designer (Full-Time, SaaS Platform)

Join to apply for the Product Designer (Full-Time, SaaS Platform) role at FirstIgnite

Base pay range
$50,000.00/yr - $75,000.00/yr

About Us FirstIgnite is at the forefront of innovation, building a cutting-edge SaaS platform that bridges the gap between academia and industry through smart technology and AI-driven tools. Our platform empowers tech transfer offices, researchers, and decision-makers with actionable insights to commercialize high-potential inventions. As we expand and scale quickly, we’re looking for a dynamic, creative, and fast-moving Product Designer to join our growing team, shape the user experience, and evolve our product to meet the needs of our diverse user base. We prize simplicity, innovation, and collaboration, and if that excites you—we’d love to have you onboard.

The Role We are searching for an exceptional Product Designer to take ownership of the end-to-end design process for our SaaS platform. As our Product Designer, you’ll be juggling between ideation, prototyping, and refinement to bring elegant and intuitive experiences to life. In an environment where speed meets thoughtfulness, you’ll have the chance to move quickly while making meaningful contributions to key product decisions. This role isn’t just about pushing pixels—it’s about working closely with Product, Engineering, and Leadership to ensure that every decision improves the user experience, feels effortless, and aligns with the overall product vision as we continue building features at a blistering pace.

What You’ll Do

  • End-to-End Design: Own the entire design cycle—from brainstorming and research to delivering high-fidelity mockups, wireframes, prototypes, and additional specifications for engineering teams.
  • Collaborate Thoughtfully: Work with product managers, engineers, and leadership to collect feedback, iterate quickly, and guide conversations about feature direction and experience.
  • Design Intuitive and Modern Interfaces: Deliver sleek, functional, and visually stunning designs that elevate the user’s experience.
  • Fluent in English: Strong verbal and written communication skills are essential for collaborating with the team and stakeholders.
  • Rapid Prototyping: Translate ideas into fast and effective mockups for approval before extensive backend resources are allocated for development.
  • Platform Usability Improvements: Audit user workflows across the SaaS platform and recommend changes to improve core usability.
  • Front-End Familiarity: Have a basic working knowledge of front-end frameworks (Vue.js, Sass/SCSS, Bulma/Buefy) to create feasible designs while collaborating with developers on what's possible. Bonus if you can help refine and implement your own designs in the code!
  • Stay Agile: Work at speed to meet evolving project deadlines while maintaining high-quality designs that meet business objectives.
  • Push the Boundaries: Explore modern design technologies and solutions to keep our platform fresh and competitive.
  • Develop Design Systems: Evolve and maintain a scalable design system with reusable components for consistent styling across the tool.

Who You Are We’re looking for a Product Designer with a mix of creativity, technical fluency, and execution speed. You should thrive in a fast-paced environment, be obsessed with how great products feel and function, and have the strategic mind to assess what’s worth investing in and when.

Here’s Your Checklist

  • Proven Experience: 3–5+ years of experience as a Product Designer (or similar roles in SaaS/Product-focused environments with web platforms).
  • Design Portfolio: A rich set of sample designs showing intuitive interface designs, thoughtful workflows, design systems, prototypes, and processes that brought measurable success to a product.
  • Rapid Prototyping Skills: Ability to create both low-fidelity wireframes and pixel-perfect high-fidelity designs with a focus on speed and flexibility.
  • Modern Design Tools: Proficiency with Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, Framer, or other preferred tools.
  • User-First Thinker: Deep understanding of user pain points, workflows, and human-centered design principles.
  • Familiarity with Front-End Frameworks: Working knowledge of Vue.js, SCSS, Bulma/Buefy or equivalent front-end principles to align design and development.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Quick to bounce ideas off team members and justify design decisions to non-design stakeholders.
  • Technical Exposure (Preferred): Basic coding skills (HTML/CSS/Vue.js) to bring designs to life on the platform.
  • Innovation-Seeker: Stay up to date on UX trends and SaaS practices to recommend emerging ideas.
  • Team Player with Ownership: Independent yet collaborative to build the best product together.
  • Detail-Oriented but Fast: Manage priorities and meet deadlines with accuracy and minimal back-and-forth.

Our Tech Stack We’re flexible. Our current stack includes Vue.js, Sass/SCSS, and Bulma/Buefy, and we value your framework familiarity and recommendations for empowering you. Collaboration with Engineering will be vital to finalizing deliverables.

Why You’ll Love Working at FirstIgnite

  • Speed and Innovation: We’re moving quickly and evolving constantly, so you’ll work on fresh, impactful challenges.
  • Collaborative Team: Respect, trust, open communication, and solution-minded teammates.
  • Impactful Work: Your designs will directly impact user experience and product decisions.
  • Opportunity to push modern boundaries in SaaS design and scaling design systems for rapid growth.
  • Design boldly, fail fast, and learn using the latest tools and trends.

What Success Looks Like

  • Designs are implemented with minimal back-and-forth due to clear communication and engineering alignment.
  • Efficient delivery of multiple feature mockups each week aligned with product timelines.
  • Clear, intuitive workflows guiding users toward goals with a strong user experience.
  • A platform design that feels modern, fast, and trustworthy within the SaaS market.

How To Apply

Please include the following: portfolio, resume, and a brief cover letter explaining why you’re excited about FirstIgnite and how your skills will elevate the product.

description:
Overview

The Medical Document Retrieval Specialist plays a pivotal role in the healthcare medical records retrieval process. As the first step in the workflow, this position ensures all requests are complete, accurate, and prepared for downstream processing. The quality of intake directly impacts the speed and accuracy of records retrieval for our law firm clients.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Provider Research & Identification
    • Determine all relevant healthcare providers associated with a client’s treatment, beyond the main facility listed by the law firm.
    • Locate billing providers and related entities using tools such as Chartswap, prior request history, and direct provider calls.
    • Input all identified providers into the admin application.
  2. Request Creation & Quality Control
    • Review and correct incoming Release of Information (ROI) forms, which are incomplete or incorrect in approximately 90% of cases.
    • Create accurate base forms before assembling final submission packets.
    • Conduct thorough quality assurance checks for each ROI packet, ensuring all required components (cover letters, affidavits, etc.) are accurate and complete.
  3. Request Assignment
    • Assign requests to appropriate records team members based on workload and utilization metrics.
  4. Handling Special Cases
    • Identify and escalate provider-specific requirements (e.g., custom forms) to the appropriate Client Success Manager (CSM).
    • Resolve missing or conflicting information by liaising directly with the law firm’s case manager.

Requirements

  • Experience: Prior experience requesting health records from providers on behalf of healthcare companies, law firms, or related organizations.
  • Attention to Detail: Extreme accuracy is essential; errors can cause months-long delays in retrieval.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in Adobe Acrobat and PDF editing/combining tools.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with a proactive problem-solving mindset.

We are expanding our online PDF editing product into a highly localized forms-based solution, starting with tax, legal, and administrative forms like W-9 and scaling globally. We’re looking for a Business Development Analyst who will drive the research, selection, preparation, and launch of high-demand forms across multiple countries.

You will work closely with Product, Marketing, and Growth teams to identify forms with the highest market demand, prepare them for integration, and help us scale our offering country by country.

  • Source, download, and prepare forms for use (incl. conversion into fillable PDF format using Acrobat or similar tools).
  • Upload prepared forms into CMS or coordinate with the product team for technical integration.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Growth, and Marketing teams to optimize rollout plans and prioritize backlog.
  • Maintain a clean, well-organized form library with proper metadata, categories, and quality standards.

Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of experience in business analysis, research, business operations, or product ops.
  • Strong research and analytical skills — ability to collect and synthesize market data quickly.
  • Hands-on experience with PDF tools (e.g., Acrobat) to prepare fillable forms.
  • Excellent organizational and documentation skills — ability to manage large content libraries.
  • Strong collaboration skills — comfortable working with cross-functional teams across Product, Marketing, and Growth.
  • Highly proactive, resourceful, and self-directed — able to independently drive projects forward.

Nice to have

  • Experience with SaaS platforms, document management, or legal/tax content.
  • Experience managing content in CMS or product data platforms.
  • Familiarity with international markets and local regulatory environments.

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ±4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

description:
Sobre a Clicksign

Somos uma empresa brasileira líder em assinaturas eletrônicas. Em essência, facilitamos relações entre pessoas e empresas no ambiente digital. Por trás da nossa tecnologia de ponta e foco em segurança, temos a missão de fazer o mundo crescer, tornando as relações digitais cada vez mais inteligentes.

Como trabalhamos: Trust é a nossa essência. Trabalhamos com foco, ritmo, comunicação clara e dados para nos apoiar. Empatia e respeito são pilares da nossa equipe.

Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Especialista em AppSec (Application Security) para compor o time de segurança da informação da Clicksign.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar como referência técnica em segurança de aplicações (web, mobile e APIs).
  • Conduzir pentests internos e externos (Ethical Hacking) e testes de segurança de aplicações.
  • Executar Threat Modeling e Code Review, propondo recomendações de mitigação de riscos.
  • Integrar práticas de segurança nos pipelines de CI/CD (DevSecOps).
  • Realizar testes automatizados de segurança (SAST, DAST, SCA) e reportar vulnerabilidades, acompanhando suas correções.
  • Avaliar e fortalecer mecanismos de autenticação, autorização e criptografia.
  • Apoiar times e projetos, garantindo Security by Design em todas as fases de desenvolvimento.
  • Conduzir workshops e treinamentos de desenvolvimento seguro.
  • Colaborar com os times internos em processos de auditoria e resposta a incidentes.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada em Pentest, Ethical Hacking e segurança de aplicações (web, mobile, APIs).
  • Conhecimento aprofundado de OWASP Top 10, CWE/SANS Top 25 e principais vulnerabilidades de aplicações.
  • Domínio de AWS Security (IAM, KMS, WAF, Config, Security Hub, GuardDuty, etc.).
  • Experiência com RASP, WAFs (Cloudflare, AWS WAF) e CSPM.
  • Certificações como OSWE, GWAPT, CSSLP, eWPT, DevSecOps Foundation ou similares.
  • Experiência prática em infraestrutura como código seguro (Terraform, CloudFormation).

Experiência com ferramentas

  • SAST: Checkmarx, Veracode, SonarQube
  • DAST: OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Acunetix
  • SCA: Snyk, WhiteSource
  • Familiaridade com containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes) com foco em segurança.
  • Experiência em DevSecOps e integração de segurança em pipelines (GitLab CI, Bitbucket, Jenkins).

Formação

  • Ensino superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Cultura de confiança, com foco em resultados, desafio e aprendizado.
  • Autonomia e protagonismo, em um ambiente colaborativo e empático.
  • Cultura de feedback e 1:1 com liderança humana e sem microgerenciamento.
  • Benefícios completos como vale refeição/alimentação, auxílios creche, home office, saúde, educação e cultura, gympass, day-off de aniversário, descontos em terapia e cursos de inglês, entre outras parcerias.

Join to apply for the Software Maintenance Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Software Maintenance Engineer to…
…work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux-based infrastructure and applications, covering all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.
This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.
You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.
Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.
The role entails

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep-dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD,Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Somos uma empresa brasileira líder em assinaturas eletrônicas. Em essência, facilitamos relações entre pessoas e empresas no ambiente digital. Por trás da nossa tecnologia de ponta e foco em segurança, temos a missão de fazer o mundo crescer, tornando as relações digitais cada vez mais inteligentes.

Como trabalhamos:

Nossa essência é o Trust. Trabalhamos com foco, ritmo, comunicação clara e dados para nos apoiar. Trabalhamos com capricho; colocamos cuidado e qualidade em tudo que fazemos. Empatia e respeito são pilares da nossa equipe.

Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Social Media criativa, estratégica e apaixonada por conteúdo digital. Essa pessoa será responsável por planejar, criar, publicar e analisar conteúdos para as nossas redes sociais, fortalecendo a presença da marca e aproximando a comunidade de forma relevante, consistente e com personalidade.

Você será o elo entre o que a marca quer comunicar e o que o público quer consumir. Sua missão será traduzir a voz da empresa em formatos diversos, acompanhar tendências e construir relacionamento nas plataformas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar como ponte entre redes sociais e negócios, identificando oportunidades de conteúdo que apoiem objetivos de vendas, produto, marca empregadora e comunidade;
  • Desenhar e liderar a estratégia de redes sociais, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos de marca, produto e crescimento;
  • Construir e manter um calendário editorial estratégico, com visão de médio e longo prazo, integrando campanhas institucionais, lançamentos e conteúdos de rotina;
  • Orientar times parceiros (como design, vídeo e conteúdo) com briefings estratégicos e criativos, garantindo entregas alinhadas à visão de marca;
  • Desenvolver guides de linguagem e comportamento nas redes para fortalecer a identidade da marca;
  • Ser guardião(a) da presença digital da marca, acompanhando interações, orientando moderação e gerenciando crises ou temas sensíveis com responsabilidade;
  • Escrever e revisar conteúdos com foco em consistência de tom de voz, clareza e impacto em diferentes plataformas (LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.);
  • Identificar e testar novos canais, formatos e tendências, com base em análises de benchmark e comportamento do público;
  • Monitorar métricas-chave de desempenho (alcance, engajamento, crescimento, retenção), gerar relatórios mensais com insights e propor planos de ação a partir deles;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Mínimo de 6 anos de experiência comprovada com produção de conteúdo e gestão de redes sociais (Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Twitter/X, Facebook);
  • Experiência sólida em planejamento estratégico de conteúdo para redes sociais (mínimo de 4–5 anos atuando com social media);
  • Domínio das principais plataformas sociais (Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Twitter/X, Facebook), com entendimento das especificidades e boas práticas de cada uma;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de agendamento e monitoramento de redes (como mLabs, Hootsuite, Etus ou similares);
  • Boa escrita e domínio da língua portuguesa (criativa, clara, adaptável por canal);
  • Conhecimento básico de ferramentas de design e edição básica (Canva, Figma, Photoshop ou similares), com autonomia para pequenas produções;
  • Capacidade de adaptar a linguagem e formatos para diferentes canais e públicos;
  • Noções de SEO para redes sociais e uso estratégico de hashtags, palavras-chave, CTAs e copywriting persuasivo.
  • Experiência com análise de métricas e KPIs de redes sociais, com habilidade de gerar insights acionáveis e relatórios estratégicos;

Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Cultura de confiança, focada em resultados e com muito desafio e aprendizado.
  • Autonomia e protagonismo, em um ambiente cheio de colaboração e empatia.
  • Cultura de feedback e 1:1 com uma liderança humana e sem microgerenciamento.
  • Benefícios completos como: vale refeição/alimentação, auxílios creche, home office, saúde, educação e cultura, gympass, day-off de aniversário, descontos em terapia e cursos de inglês, entre outras parcerias.

title: Google Ads Manager
description:
About Us

At WinTech, we are at the forefront of innovation, crafting cutting-edge consumer products that shape the future. Our diverse portfolio spans the health, education, and entertainment sectors, offering exciting opportunities to make a real impact. Our dynamic teams are the driving force behind our success, and we’re always on the lookout for passionate individuals eager to join us on this journey of transformation.

The Role

We are seeking a results-driven Google User Acquisition Manager at one of Ruby Labs' fastest-growing companies. You'll manage substantial advertising budgets across 30+ regions, optimizing Search, Display, PMax, and Demand Gen campaigns at scale. You should be prepared to work autonomously, make clear weekly strategies, and take ownership of our ad accounts with meticulous attention to performance and growth.

If you are motivated by big budgets, challenging targets, and a growth opportunity in a high-performance environment, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Peak Performance Execution: Deliver daily performance across Google Search, Display, PMax, and Demand Gen campaigns with ROI optimization and profitability maximization across 30+ regions.
  • Advanced Data Analysis & Autonomous Decision-Making: Conduct in-depth daily analysis of campaign data, uncover insights, and autonomously decide which countries and GEOs to scale, prioritizing ROI and optimal budget allocation.
  • Campaign Mastery: Launch, test, and scale Google Ads campaigns, optimizing keywords, targeting, bidding, and budget allocation to maximize campaign potential.
  • Continuous Innovation & Competitive Intelligence: Proactively research tools, platform updates, and optimization techniques while analyzing competitor strategies to maintain a competitive edge.

Qualifications

  • Proven Track Record: Minimum 4 years of hands-on Google Ads experience with demonstrated ability to scale budgets profitably and achieve ROI across multiple regions.
  • High-Budget Expertise: Experience managing significant monthly ad spend ($100K+) across Search, Display, PMax, and Demand Gen with profitability and growth results.
  • Multi-GEO Management: Experience managing campaigns across multiple countries and regions with autonomous scaling decisions based on performance data.
  • Data Mastery: Advanced analytical skills with spreadsheet proficiency (pivot tables, SUMIFS, VLOOKUP) and ability to build custom analysis models.
  • Technical Expertise: Understanding of Google Ads account structure, keyword research tools, and advanced optimization techniques.
  • Autonomous Decision-Making: Self-driven, thrives under pressure, and consistently exceeds targets in fast-paced environments.
  • Growth-Oriented: Willingness to learn, scale challenges, and grow with a high-growth company.
  • Communication Excellence: Strong English communication skills for data analysis and presenting performance insights to management.

Nice to have

  • Experience with YouTube Ads and YouTube Shorts Ads
  • Consumer products background
  • Experience in subscription-based business models

Location

WinTech operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome if located within approximately ±4 hours of CET for optimal collaboration during working hours.

Benefits

We offer a vibrant environment and the following perks:

  • Remote Work Environment
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid National Holidays
  • Company-provided MacBook
  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement

Read more about the Independent Contractor option here:

Interview Process

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, with possible longer timelines depending on volume. If there is a potential fit, the steps are:

  • Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
  • Technical Interview (90 minutes)
  • Final Interview (60 minutes)

Life at WinTech

At WinTech, you’ll join a supportive and collaborative team passionate about excellence and industry leadership. Our work environment drives impactful results as we challenge ourselves and elevate each other.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Horário de trabalho: 10h às 17h. Salário: R$ 800 + vale alimentação de R$ 29 por dia. Totalizando uma média de salário de R$ 1.380. Requisito obrigatório: para ser considerado, o candidato deve entrar em contato com sua instituição de ensino, manifestar interesse pelo estágio e solicitar o Termo de Compromisso de Estágio. Este documento é obrigatório para a contratação; sem o Termo de Compromisso de Estágio, não será possível concluir o processo de seleção e iniciar o estágio.

É obrigatório estar cursando o 3º ano da faculdade de Comunicação e Marketing, Design Gráfico ou áreas relacionadas. Perfil de candidato: proativo, criativo, organizado, responsável e com vontade de aprender. Capacidade de gerenciar várias tarefas e cumprir prazos.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Auxiliar na criação de arte para diversas mídias digitais (Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, e-mail marketing, folders, cartões de visita, entre outros).
  • Auxiliar na edição de vídeos para reels, timeline, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook e TikTok.
  • Desenvolver conteúdo criativo para posts em Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest e TikTok.
  • Agendamento de posts em todas as plataformas.
  • Criação e envio de e-mail marketing.
  • Auxiliar em tarefas diversas conforme necessidade.

Perfil Desejado

  • Curso de graduação obrigatório em Marketing, Design Gráfico, Publicidade ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Bom conhecimento de português, habilidades de redação e interpretação de texto.
  • Conhecimento básico em marketing digital e edição de imagem/vídeo com bom senso estético.
  • Conhecimento básico em Pacotes Office, Facebook e Instagram.
  • Familiaridade com programas de edição como Photoshop, Canva, Corel; conhecimento de monitoramento de desempenho será valorizado.
  • Boa comunicação para trabalho em equipe; capacidade de gerenciar várias tarefas simultaneamente; auto-gerenciamento para cumprir prazos e metas.

Como Se Candidatar

Se você é apaixonado pelo mundo do marketing digital, está disposto a aprender e deseja fazer parte da nossa equipe, envie seu currículo e uma breve carta de apresentação com o assunto: Estagiário de Criação - Seu Nome. Destaque seu interesse pela vaga, adicione exemplos de artes que já tenha produzido e demonstre seu potencial para crescer como membro da equipe. Estamos ansiosos para receber sua candidatura e ajudar no desenvolvimento de suas habilidades em Design Gráfico.

Sobre a nossa empresa

Somos uma agência de marketing digital totalmente online, com atendimento voltado para nichos específicos de mercado. Possuímos vasta experiência e excelência nos serviços oferecidos. Valorizamos profissionais éticos, responsáveis e criativos, que desejem somar ao nosso time. Acreditamos na diversidade e inclusão e incentivamos candidaturas de pessoas com diferentes histórias, representando a pluralidade do nosso país.

title: Marketing Analytics | Sênior (Remoto)
description:
Overview

Marketing Analytics | Sênior (Remoto) at Stone

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no cliente. Nosso propósito é transformar a indústria de pagamentos, servindo o empreendedor brasileiro e gerando resultados. Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas em todo o país. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e pensamentos disruptivos na busca de soluções para a nossa missão.

Nossa Cultura

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por 5 pilares: Own It, Live the Ride, No Bullshit, Team Play, The Reason. Queremos gerar impacto para nossos clientes por meio de entregas relevantes.

Missão Do Time De Marketing Analytics

A área de Marketing Analytics tem como principal objetivo monitorar e otimizar a performance das campanhas de mídia, integrando dados de diversas fontes e fornecendo análises que apoiem decisões estratégicas. Buscamos alguém com forte capacidade analítica, domínio técnico em manipulação de dados (foco em SQL e BigQuery) e conhecimento em mídia paga (Google, Meta, programática, entre outros).

Como é Ser Um(a) Analista De Marketing Analytics

Essa pessoa será responsável por acompanhar e interpretar os principais KPIs das campanhas, gerar hipóteses e testes para melhoria de performance, propor insights acionáveis e garantir a visibilidade dos resultados para os stakeholders. As principais atividades a serem executadas serão:

  • Realizar análises profundas de canais, audiências, criativos e jornada de conversão;
  • Analisar o desempenho das campanhas de mídia digital;
  • Criar e manter dashboards automatizados em ferramentas como Looker Studio ou similares;
  • Manipular grandes volumes de dados usando SQL e BigQuery;
  • Levantar hipóteses com base em dados e validar com testes A/B ou análises comparativas;
  • Apoiar a definição de metas e KPIs junto aos times de marketing e negócios;
  • Trabalhar próximo das áreas de mídia, CRM, branding e produto para priorizar iniciativas com base em impacto;
  • Acompanhar e interpretar métricas de atribuição, CAC, LTV, ROI e outras métricas relevantes;
  • Criar documentação clara e objetiva dos aprendizados das análises realizadas.

O Que Esperamos De Você

  • Experiência prévia em Marketing Analytics, mídia de performance ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio de SQL e experiência com BigQuery;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de visualização de dados como Looker Studio, Power BI ou Tableau;
  • Sólido conhecimento de KPIs de marketing e funis de conversão;
  • Capacidade de traduzir dados em histórias claras e estratégicas para diferentes públicos.

O Que Aumentam Suas Chances

  • Experiência com modelagem de atribuição ou marketing mix modeling;
  • Conhecimento em Python ou R para análises estatísticas;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de automação de marketing; experiência em ambientes com squads multidisciplinares.

Jornada De Trabalho

  • 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 | Segunda a Sexta.

Modelo/Local De Trabalho

  • Remoto. Se a pessoa residir em SP capital, o time irá ao escritório de forma periódica.

Entrevistas com o time de People: conheça nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio proposto.

title: Security Risk Management Specialist
description:
Overview

In security risk management we're looking to harness the power of industry best practice combined with driving new innovation on how we do security risk assessments and modelling. Our security risk management team is the primary owner of the strategy and practices of how we identify, track and reduce our security risk across everything we do. To support this we need to use industry best practices paired with emerging threat information to promote risk identification, quantification, impact analysis, and modelling to ultimately drive decision making. In this role, you will help establish and execute a broad strategic vision for the security risk program at Canonical. You will work within the team and cross-functionally with various teams across the organisation, contributing ideas and requirements for Canonical product security to improve resilience for Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attacks. The team also collaborates with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate security training across Canonical.

The security risk management team\'s mission is to secure Canonical and contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They may share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, share threat intelligence with the wider community, or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

Responsibilities

  • Define Canonical\'s security risk management standards and playbooks
  • Analyse and improve Canonical\'s security risk practices
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security requirements, tools and practices
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical security risk management practice
  • Develop Canonical security risk learning and development materials
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change
  • Participate in developing key risk indicators, and provide inputs to the development of key control indicators and key performance indicators for various programs
  • Apply statistical models to risk frameworks (such as FAIR, sensitivity analysis, and others)
  • Participate in risk management, decision-making, and collaborative discussions
  • Lead quantified risk assessments and understand the value of qualitative data for improvements to quality and engineering processes
  • Interpret internal or external cyber security risk analyses in business terms and recommend a responsible course of action
  • Develop templates and materials to help with self-service risk management actions
  • Monitor and identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness of risk management processes
  • Launch campaigns to perform security assessments and help mitigate security risks across the company
  • Build evaluation methods and performance indicators to measure the efficiency of security functions and capabilities

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Problem-solver with excellent communication skills, a deep technical understanding of security assessments and risk management
  • Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks
  • Broad knowledge of how to operationalize the management of security risk
  • Experience in Secure Development Lifecycle and Security by Design methodology

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Descrição da empresa

A Eurofins Scientific é uma empresa internacional de ciências da vida que fornece uma gama única de serviços de testes analíticos para clientes em vários setores. O Grupo acredita que é o líder mundial em análises de produtos alimentícios e farmacêuticos, matrizes ambientais e em serviços de CRO de agrosciences. É também um dos líderes de mercados independentes globais para de certos testes e serviços laboratoriais para genômica, pesquisa farmacológica, ciência forense, ciências de materiais avançadas e para apoio a estudos clínicos. Além disso, a Eurofins é um dos principais players emergentes em testes de diagnóstico clínico especializados na Europa e nos EUA.

Os números-chave do grupo são aproximadamente: Faturamento de 3,8 bilhões de euros, mais de 800 laboratórios em 47 países e cerca de 45.000 funcionários.

Descrição da vaga

Executar as técnicas analíticas descritas nos procedimentos da empresa, com análise crítica dos resultados, atendendo aos prazos, mantendo a organização e zelando pela segurança e integridade de todos.

RESPONSABILIDADES :

  • Realizar e supervisionar as diferentes etapas analíticas, incluindo pesagem, extração e homogeneização, por exemplo;
  • Treinar novos colaboradores e acompanhar auxiliares e estagiários em procedimentos quando solicitado pelo Coordenador do Setor
  • Incluir os resultados avaliados, repetições e análises adicionais no sistema (de acordo com a respectiva linha de negócio), bem como registrar informações pertinentes;
  • Realizar a solicitação de compra de materiais para o laboratório no sistema com supervisão da Coordenação, se necessário;
  • Auxiliar o envio de materiais para calibração;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento e orientação dos Assistentes, Auxiliares e Estagiários;
  • Revisar e criar novos documentos no sistema de Gestão da Qualidade;
  • Participar de forma supervisionada nas validações, no que tange as etapas analíticas;
  • Comunicar com a área de cadastro (Login/Triagem) quanto às amostras em processamento, seguida de impressão de mapa de trabalho. Armazenar essas amostras de forma organizada no setor.
  • Auxiliar na checagem de resultados analíticos / análises críticas;
  • Executar os ensaios de proficiência;
  • Comunicar qualquer problema na rotina do laboratório junto ao Analista Sênior ou Coordenação;
  • Realizar as tarefas gerais do laboratório de acordo com a divisão de tarefas definidas pelo Coordenador que pode incluir: preparo de materiais (soluções, tampões, meios de cultura, soluções padrão), checagem de temperaturas, validade das soluções e reagentes em uso;
  • Comunicar a necessidade de materiais e necessidade de manutenção corretiva e preventiva dos equipamentos ao Analista Sênior ou Coordenação, e quando necessário realizar as manutenções periódicas nos equipamentos seguindo as recomendações do fabricante e as orientações do Analista Sênior ou Coordenador
  • Manter os freezers, geladeiras, armários, gavetas, prateleiras e bancadas organizados, mantendo cada insumo armazenado em temperatura preconizada pelo fabricante (ambiente, refrigerado ou congelado);
  • Limpar e desinfetar a área de trabalho (bancada) antes e depois da rotina, seguindo o procedimento específico;
  • Vistoriar mensalmente os insumos quanto à data de vencimento; informar o Coordenador do Setor com antecedência sobre o vencimento e realizar o descarte quando necessário;
  • Utilizar todos os EPIs necessários para a realização das tarefas com segurança e de acordo com as normas de segurança dos laboratórios;
  • Arquivar documentos de acordo com treinamento da qualidade;
  • Segregar e descartar os resíduos.
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade, ou a critério de seu superior.

Qualificações

Necessário experiência com GC/MS ou ICP-OES/MS, de preferência em áreas ambientais.

description:
Overview

Regulatory Affairs Specialist (LATAM) responsible for the day-to-day activities and delivery of Global Regulatory Affairs support services. Role will include management of clinical trial applications to Competent Authorities, Ethics Committees and Regulatory Agencies, and the research, review and reporting on applicable global regulations and requirements. Develop stakeholder tools, process/document regulatory risk assessments, and provide support, expertise and represent the unit with other functional units, sponsors, researchers and/or regulatory authorities.   • Participate in specialized conferences/meetings to increase knowledge as needed.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Overview

Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We’re building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. Darkroom has been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. ), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).

As a hands-on Digital Marketing Manager, you’ll bring sharp strategy, organizational excellence, and creative instinct to every project. This role blends content strategy, project management, copywriting, and digital performance analysis - perfect for someone who thrives on moving seamlessly between planning and execution. You’ll be the glue connecting design, video, and messaging, turning ideas into structured campaigns that perform across IG, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and email.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST time zone, open to candidates in Portugal and Brazil.

What You’ll Do

  • Strategy, Planning & Execution: Own the content calendar; plan, manage, and execute the content pipeline across IG, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok and email using Notion.
  • Coordinate across teams: Work with the Design Lead and Video Lead to align on timelines, asset creation, and creative strategy.
  • Deploy consistently: Schedule and publish all organic social posts and newsletters; ensure content is on-message and on time.
  • Stay agile: Adapt to shifting priorities and post needs without dropping quality or speed.
  • Coordinate the email pipeline: Plan email newsletters.
  • Drive Darkroom’s email strategy: Support strategic initiatives for Darkroom’s email marketing campaigns in partnership with the Design Lead and Video Lead.

Social Media Management

  • Hands-on ownership of Darkroom’s organic presence on Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.
  • Write copy: Post captions, headlines and descriptions that match platform-specific tone and brand voice.
  • Community engagement: Monitor and respond to comments and DMs. Actively engage with customers, creators, and collaborators.

Paid Media

  • Understand paid social and ad copywriting and collaborate with the paid media specialist on Darkroom’s paid ads.

SEO, Reporting, Analytics & Performance

  • Work with our SEO specialist to track performance across all owned platforms and campaigns (social, email, website).
  • SEO + UX insights: Use Microsoft Clarity and Google Analytics to identify friction points and opportunities for optimization.
  • Report intelligently: Provide actionable insights, trends, and growth metrics that influence creative direction.

You’re a Great Fit If You

  • Have 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, with a strong focus on content, email, and social.
  • Are highly organized, autonomous, and thrive in fast-paced, iterative environments.
  • Write with precision and tone, and know how to adapt voice across channels.
  • Know what content performs, and why.
  • Have strong project management instincts and can juggle timelines, tasks and tools.
  • Understand digital performance: you’ve worked with analytics tools, know your way around email metrics and think SEO.
  • Communicate clearly and can collaborate with designers and video editors.

Bonus Points If You

  • Have experience working inside an agency.
  • Have managed newsletter content and owned media channels.
  • Are fluent in Notion, Figma, Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, GT Metrix.
  • Have worked on brand-led social content.

What It’s Like To Work At Darkroom

We’re building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:

  • Unlimited Vacation Policy and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
  • Remote-first culture with hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Equity incentives and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche through cross-functional collaboration.
  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this transition, ensuring time to bond with families while maintaining work-life balance.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
