Overview

Join to apply for the Mechanical & Plumbing BIM Specialist role at ENG .

The Role

The BIM Specialist role covers modeling of different trades (MEP), depending on background and project scope (specific zones or entire buildings). Responsibilities include ensuring high-quality modeling (expertise, technical knowledge, LOD and QAQC) with autonomy in self-management. A BIM Specialist helps clients by detecting conflicts during the initial information review, modeling, and coordination phases.

Minimum mandatory requirements

  • Excellent level of English is an absolute must, both spoken and written. Candidates must be able to engage in fluent conversations with native and non-native speakers. Candidates without this requirement will NOT be considered.
  • Solid experience modeling HVAC and plumbing in Revit for commercial, industrial, healthcare, and residential construction. This includes process piping, ductwork, sheet metal, mechanical equipment (pumps, AHUs, RTUs, chillers, boilers), and plumbing (domestic water, sanitary drainage, gray water, stormwater, medical gases, compressed air lines, pumps, heaters, and hangers).
  • Experience coordinating or clash-detecting through Navisworks (Revizto considered but Navisworks preferred); knowledge of BIM coordination, clash reports, QAQC, and model accuracy.
  • A mechanical or civil engineering bachelor’s degree (architects could be considered if they have extensive experience modeling and coordinating MEP trades).

Desirable/Additional requirements

Specific requirements vary by position and service. Experience with LOD 400 and projects based in the US , or constructability knowledge related to that country, is a huge differential . Other desirable items include:

  • Familiarity with BIM add-ins (e.g., Evolve , SysQue , Fabrication Parts ).
  • Experience in conceptual design / BIM design assist.
  • AutoCAD Plant 3D knowledge.
  • Dynamo/Python knowledge applied to BIM.
  • On-site/field experience .
  • Ability to produce detailed models, including real-world fittings and connection types .

Please note: if you don’t have experience working with Revit in formal jobs, it will be hard to be considered. Also, please ensure your English level meets the requirement.

About ENG

Who we are: ENG (engbim.com) is a BIM company that specializes in hands-on, field-focused BIM services. Founded in 2007, we are the largest and most experienced BIM production service provider in the United States, having completed 5,000 BIM projects with a dedicated team of over 500 staff members. We provide MEP Modeling, VDC/BIM Management, Laser Scanning, and Scan to BIM services, as well as a comprehensive array of BIM production services to architects, engineers, and owners.

Work arrangements & Benefits

  • Work from Anywhere: Flexibility to work remotely or from a coworking space.
  • Paid time off: Flexible paid time off when you need it.
  • Wellness & Culture: Freedom and responsibility culture, healthy snack allowances, team celebrations.
  • Continuous Learning: Programs to develop technical and soft skills.
  • Work Equipment: Equipment provided to create a productive workspace.
  • Tech & Office Allowances: One-time allowances to upgrade devices and home office setup.
  • Monthly Internet Allowance: Monthly allowance for internet and related expenses.
  • Compensation: Highly competitive package, in USD, with fixed and variable components.
  • Join us and grow in a flexible, innovative environment!

Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This role involves working in a dynamic Linux-based infrastructure and applications environment, spanning all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications used by large enterprise customers.

This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.

Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.

Responsibilities

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical\'s Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep-dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice-to-have skills

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD, PostgreSQL, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems

What we offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
• We’re looking for individuals with hands-on startup and SaaS experience who thrive in fast-paced, product-driven environments.
  • While we value diverse backgrounds, applicants whose experience is exclusively within consulting firms may not be the best fit for this role.
  • Please submit your resume in English to ensure a smooth review process.

---

This is an opportunity to build something truly big. You will have a direct impact on the industry and the way people travel, connect, and discover the world. That is the kind of work you can expect at Enso Connect.

What we do

Enso Connect is a guest experience platform for vacation rentals and boutique hotels that seamlessly plugs into property management systems to personalize and monetize interactions throughout the entire guest journey. From AI-driven messaging and contactless check-in to upsells and verification, we are the "Zapier of hospitality" - connecting all the tools you already love while increasing profit per guest.

We are a well-funded startup with strong product-market fit and excellent sales momentum. We are expanding rapidly and need to scale our engineering team. Our current tech team is around 12 people. We operate as a true meritocracy where the best ideas win regardless of seniority. We have an energetic culture that moves fast. Every engineer has a voice in technical and product decisions.

You will be joining our engineering team to help build this mission-critical system that processes thousands of bookings daily for hospitality businesses worldwide. This is a full-time remote position (38-40 hrs/week) that requires high autonomy and self-direction, with significant ownership over your work and direct connection to business impact and clients. We require overlap of at least 3 hours with EST business hours (9 AM - 5 PM EST). On rare occasions, system outages may require attention outside of regular business hours.

Who You Are

As a full stack software developer, you will be instrumental in the architecture, design, development, delivery and support of key features and integrations. You will work closely with our development team throughout the entire development lifecycle to solve diverse business & technical challenges.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Gathering requirements & feedback from stakeholders (sales, client success, product) to address business & technical challenges
  • Architecting & scoping solutions that strike the right balance between quality and velocity
  • Build and maintain scalable features & improvements end to end, including testing & deployment
  • Managing your tasks & communicating changes in your own timelines pro-actively
  • Monitoring your work post-deploy to ensure a high level of quality and positive feedback from users
  • Collaborate on architecture decisions for a clean and easy to maintain system
  • Participating in design sessions and code reviews with peers to elevate the quality of engineering across the organization

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience building and maintaining web applications, ideally with a strong backend focus.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, event-driven systems, and RESTful APIs.
  • Comfortable designing and implementing features end-to-end, including architecture, infrastructure, frontend/backend logic, testing, and deployment.
  • Experience working in a cloud-native environment, ideally with AWS Lambda, SQS/SNS, API Gateway, OpenSearch, and serverless Framework.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD workflows, testing (unit, integration), and monitoring tools like DataDog or CloudWatch.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. You enjoy working closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and support teams.
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Cursor, etc) to accelerate development and improve engineering workflows.

Nice To Haves

  • Experience creating and modifying end to end integrations using API specifications and UX guidelines.
  • Serverless infrastructure experience, specifically AWS & FaaS
  • Experience working at startups / Proptech
  • Experience working directly with the customer / end user to triage problems.
  • Bonus if you are available for occasional in-person work in downtown Toronto, but you would be required to have a overlap of at least 3 hours with EST business hours.

Why Us?

  • We are a dynamic and innovative company that is dedicated to making a positive impact in the hospitality industry. Our team is made up of passionate and dedicated individuals who are committed to driving change and pushing boundaries. We offer a collaborative and dynamic work environment that encourages creativity and growth.
  • Our company is known for its industry-leading technology
  • By joining us you will have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects, be part of a culture that values your contributions and have access to ample resources and training to help you achieve your professional goals.

Benefits and Perks

  • Unlimited Vacation : As long as key deliverables are met, you have unlimited time off
  • Employee Stock Options : Option for ESOP participation as part of compensation plan
  • Remote-First Culture : Fully remote with flexible hours (within EST overlap requirements)
  • Direct Impact : Your work directly affects business outcomes and client success
  • Growth Opportunities : Rapid company growth means expanded responsibilities and career advancement

Enso Connect is committed to creating a diverse environment and is an equal-opportunity employer. Enso Connect does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or disability status.

Join to apply for the Editor, Marketing role at Darkroom .

As a Video Editor on Darkroom’s internal Marketing Team, you’ll shape the visual storytelling behind our brand. You’ll transform raw content into engaging, high-impact videos for platforms like Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and LinkedIn. This is a fast-moving, creative, and collaborative role for someone with sharp instincts, strong technical skills, and a passion for crafting content that connects with audiences.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

What You’ll Do

  • Edit and produce standout content across short-form (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) and long-form (YouTube, webinars).
  • Create native video formats optimized for IG, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and X, including repurposed edits and cutdowns.
  • Build scroll-stopping hooks, apply text overlays, closed captions, sound design, and motion graphics that support performance.
  • Turn voice notes, podcasts, webinars and interviews into polished, platform-native video content.
  • Surface and extract the most compelling moments from raw footage: podcast soundbites, behind-the-scenes gems, founder tangents, interviews, etc.
  • Collaborate with the Video Lead on edits, structure, and narrative framing.
  • Organize, tag, and manage footage to create a systemized pipeline for recurring content formats.
  • Understand performance data and collaborate with the marketing team to refine editing strategies based on what drives reach, engagement, and conversion.
  • Test hooks, variations and formats to optimize output over time.
  • Stay ahead of editing trends and platform algorithm shifts.

Production Excellence

  • Apply finishing touches: color correction, transitions, graphics, and text effects that align with the Darkroom brand language.
  • Deliver content in multiple aspect ratios and formats for cross-platform distribution.
  • Maintain high audio fidelity, visual clarity, and consistent branding across deliverables.
  • Proactively troubleshoot creative or technical challenges and recommend solutions.
  • Support post-production for Darkroom’s podcast and event recordings.
  • Add intros/outros, audio enhancements, and accessible subtitles.

You’re a Great Fit If You:

  • Have 3-4+ years of experience editing content for social-first brands, creators, or agencies.
  • Know your way around Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, and have working knowledge of After Effects, Photoshop and motion graphics.
  • Have a sharp eye for storytelling, pacing, and rhythm, and you know how to build content that keeps attention.
  • Understand editing for performance, not just aesthetics. You know what performs on TikTok vs. YouTube Shorts vs. LinkedIn.
  • Are fluent in optimizing content across multiple aspect ratios and formats.
  • Can own your edit from concept to final export while staying collaborative, communicative, and open to feedback.
  • Thrive in fast-paced, feedback-rich environments where no two days (or edits) are the same.
  • Are organized, meticulous, and always ready with a plan B (or C).

Bonus Points If You:

  • Have experience editing founder-led content or personal brand material.
  • Have worked on performance-driven or growth marketing creative.
  • Use AI tools (Descript, Runway, etc.) for cutdowns, transcription, or speeding up your workflow.

  • Unlimited Vacation Policy and Holidays: flexible vacation policy and 10 holidays per year.

Symplicity is looking for a Client Manager to join our team! Symplicity's Client Manager (SCM) Team members are responsible for communicating with clients, ensuring happiness with our services, and building a relationship with individuals to better meet their needs from lead acquisition, to system support.

The SCM will partner with Symplicity functional areas to lead streamlined service to assigned schools/clients and increase adoption of the product while working with clients to develop their goals within the system. He/she will create and maintain systems knowledge on Symplicity’s suite of products and act as product manager while collaborating with clients to maximize their investment in Symplicity through individualized support, training, and process improvement.

· Advance a trusted advisor relationship while driving towards successful delivery and implementation of any new services.

· Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within client base and work with Account Executives to ensure these opportunities.

· Continue expertise on industry and client best practices and trends.

· Develop client case studies, success stories, and references.

· Lead efforts to identify and turn around at-risk clients.

· Encourage customer feedback and participation through webinars, roadshows and feedback sessions.

· Work with the billing team to assist in any issues, invoices, and new sales quotes.

· Actively support quick and effective implementation of new Symplicity systems assigned in conjunction with Transition Support Specialists.

· Work with clients to establish critical goals, or other key performance indicators and aid the customer in achieving their goals.

· Engage in day-to-day communications with clients to ensure we are maximizing their experience and success with their Symplicity Systems.

· Bachelor’s degree

· Experience working with Symplicity's products

· Detail oriented; problem solving skills

· Communication skills (verbal and written)

· Strong interest in the Higher Education space

· Outgoing, high energy, friendly personality

· Personal initiative, self-motivated

· Team player, cooperative, flexible

· Ethical business standards

About Symplicity

Symplicity is the market leader in employability solutions. We help companies find talent, we help Higher Ed bridge the skills gap and we help recent college graduates launch their careers. Used by over 30 million students worldwide, our comprehensive suite of products touches the full life cycle of a student. From admission to alumni engagement, Symplicity’s products cover career services, advising, student conduct, campus life as well as housing & residence life.Symplicity is proud to be an equal and diverse Employer. EEO/AAP/M/F/Disabled/Veteran. Please note: employment with Symplicity contingent on successful completion of background check.

title: Product Lead (Remote - Brazil)
description:
Overview

Product Lead (Remote - Brazil) at DBServices Portugal . We’re looking for a Product Lead to join a fast-paced, collaborative project. You’ll be responsible for uncovering product needs, aligning stakeholders, and guiding the delivery of impactful solutions from discovery to implementation. You’ll work closely with designers, engineers, and client teams to ensure every product decision is rooted in user value and business outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Help clients define product vision and user objectives, maintaining strong client relationships
  • Work with internal and external team members to define feature lists that align with the client\'s strategy
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to iteratively build solutions that are in line with time and budget constraints
  • Facilitate conversations around scope management and feature prioritization
  • Elicit requirements from stakeholders and manage complex requirement backlogs that consider multiple platforms
  • Build a shared understanding of product requirements among all stakeholders (internal and external)
  • Understand and advocate for the end-users needs
  • Contribute to a strategic product roadmap that prioritizes features according to the client\'s vision
  • Work alongside engineers to understand system architecture and data flows to guide feature development
  • Manage and document technical dependencies and API needs for use in feature implementations
  • Collaborate with product designers and engineers to create best-in-class user experiences that are feasible and within technical constraints

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in the software development industry as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Technical Business Analyst, Requirements Manager, or related position
  • An understanding of the software development life-cycle (SDLC) and experience working with one or more software development methodologies
  • Demonstrated experience with AI technologies in personal and/or professional contexts
  • Experience working closely with stakeholders to elicit and define requirements for at least one of the following platforms: iOS, Android, Web
  • Strong documentation and technical writing skills, with familiarity working with user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, flow diagrams, user personas, and API documentation
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
  • Ability to size solutions based on project constraints, i.e., time/scope/budget
  • Experience identifying and mitigating risks that could affect project outcomes
  • Ability to communicate clearly, confidently, and tactfully and to simplify technical concepts for non-technical audiences
  • Knowledge of frontend and backend technologies (i.e., web/native apps, APIs, databases) and the risks and constraints of different technologies
  • An understanding of and deep appreciation for the topic of user experience (UX) and a drive to stay up-to-date with the continually evolving landscape
  • Self-starter who takes initiative in solving problems and can self-manage commitments and deadlines
  • Advanced English

Benefits

  • Collaborative Environment: We value a sense of community where ideas are shared, and achievements are celebrated as a team.
  • Work from Anywhere: Freedom and flexibility to work from wherever you feel most productive and comfortable.
  • Global Connection: Opportunity to interact with people from different countries and cultures, expanding your network and worldview.
  • Physical Health Support: Through TotalPass and Mediquo, resources and programs, and telemedicine dedicated to your physical well-being.
  • Mental Health Care: Team Care provides initiatives and actions to support your emotional and mental balance in daily life.

Why DBServices? At DBServices, we design, develop, and support cutting-edge digital platforms that drive innovation for leading companies across IT, Banking, Retail, Government, Healthcare, and other industries in Europe and the Americas. Our expertise empowers businesses to grow, adapt, and lead in dynamic markets.

Trusted by industry leaders like Worten, Sonae, Edenred, Natixis, Farfetch, Glintt, Efacec, Segurança Social, and McDonald\'s, we deliver solutions that make a real impact. Join us and be part of a global team that\'s shaping the future of digital transformation.

description:
Nível: Consultor

Cursos de: Administração, Comercial, Tecnologia

Escolaridade: Graduação - Administração, Comercial, Tecnologia - Completo

Tipo de contrato: CLT

Jornada de trabalho: Horário de trabalho: das 08h00 às 12h00 e das 13h30 às 18h00

Disponibilidade para home-office: Sim

Responsabilidades

Você fará parte de um time comercial com foco em novos negócios; nosso cliente é do setor de tecnologia e atua com soluções jurídicas para grandes empresas.

  • Conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas: prospecção, qualificação, demonstração, elaboração da proposta, negociação e fechamento;
  • Participar e dar apoio operacional em feiras e eventos para fomentar a venda dos nossos produtos/serviços;
  • Participar de reuniões com executivos de diversas áreas, negócios, TI, compras, etc.;
  • Conduzir reuniões de entendimento e levantamento de escopo do projeto para a elaboração de propostas comerciais alinhadas às necessidades de cada cliente;
  • Manter todos os dados atualizados no CRM, como registros de prospecção, apresentações comerciais e follow-ups;
  • Manter atualizado e monitorar o funil de vendas e desempenho do pipeline, identificando oportunidades e riscos potenciais a fim de garantir o atingimento das metas;
  • Colaborar com as demais áreas da empresa: marketing, projetos/consultoria, sucesso do cliente, etc.

Requisitos

O que você precisa ter:

  • Superior completo ou cursando em áreas correlatas (Administração, Direito, afins);
  • Experiência na área comercial com foco em novas contas, especialmente em venda consultiva de software B2B;
  • Uso de ferramentas de CRM e análise de dados;
  • Histórico de atingimento de metas e condução de negociações complexas;
  • Familiaridade com o público jurídico, compras, negócios e TI;
  • Excelente comunicação, escuta ativa e perfil consultivo;
  • Residir em São Paulo (SP) ou região metropolitana e ter disponibilidade para representar a empresa em feiras e eventos
  • Disponibilidade para viagens pontuais.

Diferenciais

  • Ter atuado em venda de software-ERP jurídico e/ou software para gestão de contratos (CLM)
  • Conhecimento em metodologias como BANT, SPIN Selling ou similares.
  • Experiência com vendas para médias e grandes empresas e escritórios de advocacia de grande porte.
  • Experiência em atuar na modalidade home-office

Observação: Vaga remota, porém é necessário residir em São Paulo ou região metropolitana, pois pontualmente irá representar a empresa em reuniões e eventos presenciais com clientes.

O Que Oferecemos

  • Vale Alimentação e Refeição sem desconto
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • PLR (Programa de Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados)
  • Auxílio Home Office
  • Bônus de Final de Ano (no mês de dezembro é creditado um valor de alimentação no cartão Flash)
  • Programa de Indicação

title: Estagiário De Designer Gráfico - Oportunidade De Crescimento Profissional!
description:
Estagiário De Designer Gráfico - Oportunidade De Crescimento Profissional

Estagiário de Design Gráfico - Criação de Mídias Digitais

Atenção: Esta é uma vaga de estágio. Interessados, por favor, leiam até o final para verificar os requisitos necessários para a vaga.

Requisitos obrigatórios

Para que o candidato seja considerado para a vaga de estágio, é imprescindível que entre em contato com sua instituição de ensino, manifeste interesse pelo estágio e solicite a eles o Termo de Compromisso de Estágio. Este documento é obrigatório para a efetivação da contratação. Sem o Termo de Compromisso de Estágio, não será possível concluir o processo de seleção e iniciar o estágio.

Condições de Trabalho

  • Horário de trabalho: 10h às 17h
  • Salário: R$ 800 + vale alimentação de R$ 29 por dia. Totalizando uma média de R$ 1.380 de salário.
  • Informações adicionais: a posição é remota, de segunda a sexta-feira.
  • Requisito acadêmico: estar cursando o 3º ano da faculdade de Comunicação e Marketing, Design Gráfico ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Você é uma pessoa disponível, responsável, proativa, criativa, organizada e com vontade de aprender?

Principais responsabilidades

  • Auxiliar na criação de layouts para posts em todas as plataformas digitais;
  • Edição de vídeos para reels, timeline, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook e TikTok;
  • Criação de peças digitais com direcionamento do superior;
  • Desenvolvimento de conteúdo criativo para posts de Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest e TikTok;
  • Agendamento de posts em todas as plataformas;
  • Criação e envio de e-mail marketing;
  • Auxiliar em tarefas diversas;

Perfil Desejado / Qualificações

  • Cursar graduação em Marketing, Design Gráfico, Publicidade ou áreas relacionadas é obrigatório.
  • Bom conhecimento de português, habilidades de redação e interpretação de texto;
  • Conhecimento básico em marketing digital;
  • Entendimento de Pacotes Office, Facebook e Instagram;
  • Muita responsabilidade, organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Capacidade de gerenciar várias tarefas simultaneamente;
  • Responsabilidade e capacidade de se auto-gerenciar, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos e metas estabelecidos;
  • Conhecimento básico em edição de imagem e vídeo, com bom senso estético;
  • Boa comunicação para trabalho em equipe;
  • Familiaridade com programas de edição como Photoshop, Canva, Corel;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de monitoramento de desempenho será valorizada.

Como Se Candidatar

Se você é apaixonado pelo mundo do marketing digital, está disposto a aprender e deseja fazer parte de nossa equipe, envie seu currículo e uma breve carta de apresentação. No assunto, escreva: Estagiário de Criação - Seu Nome. Destaque seu interesse pela vaga, acrescente exemplos de artes que você já tenha produzido e destaque o seu potencial para crescer como um membro valioso de nossa equipe.

Estamos ansiosos para receber sua candidatura e ajudá-lo a desenvolver suas habilidades em Design Gráfico.

Quem Somos

Somos uma agência de marketing digital totalmente online, com atendimento voltado para nichos específicos de mercado. Possuímos vasta experiência e excelência nos serviços que oferecemos. Trabalhamos com dedicação e paixão e buscamos pessoas que gostem de trabalhar, tenham interesse em comunicação, sejam criativas e não tenham medo de enfrentar novos desafios. Valorizamos profissionais éticos e responsáveis, dispostos a somar ao nosso time. Acreditamos na importância da diversidade e inclusão e encorajamos candidaturas de pessoas com diferentes histórias, representando a pluralidade do nosso país. Acreditamos que uma equipe formada por indivíduos diversos nos torna mais criativos e inovadores.

Since our inception, we have grown to be a team of over 3,000 employees in 35 countries around the world. InComm Payments is highly focused on our people and their growth, and we work hard to make a career at InComm Payments meaningful and rewarding. We value innovation, quality, passion, integrity and responsibility in all that we do, and we are looking for great people to join our team as we move forward towards a very bright future. We anticipate developing future leaders for our teams in Brazil!

Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses! All positions are CLT.

You can learn more about InComm Payments by visiting our Website or connecting with us on LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitter, Facebook, or Instagram

About This Opportunity

As a Data Management Coordinator you play a vital role in ensuring that data is accurate and updated in our Master Data Management Systems. This position ensures timely and accurate updates of existing locations by insuring that they have valid addresses and other required master data information in the Master Data Management (MDM) system, while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction within the organization.

This position is CLT and Fully Remote in Brazil . Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses! Professional English communication skills are required.

Responsibilities

Process all incoming assignments within the standard 2 business days

  • Primary responsibility will be Location Maintenance in MDM to include but not limited to the following:
  • New Location Setups
  • Update Info to existing Locations
  • Location Name Changes
  • Location & Merchant Moves
  • Location Closures
  • Merchant Inactivation
  • Location Special Projects as assigned by the Manager
  • Track new location address adds in MDM for reporting purposes and any other metric information as needed
  • Work closely with Sales and Account Management for collection, review, update, and entry of master data information in MDM
  • Will support and work with the Contract Admin team and the FDT (Finance Data Team) team as it relates to data entry and updates and any other special duties as assigned by the Manager of the Data Administration Team (DAT)

Qualifications

  • College Degree preferred but not required
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Must be proficient in Microsoft Office Excel spreadsheets and other related functions; must have experience using V-LOOKUP and other report comparison functions
  • Must be able to learn new skills and applications quickly
  • Must be able to communicate clearly and work well with others
  • Must be able to stay focused on project related tasks that are repetitive
  • Must be able to type at least 50+ wpm
  • Prefer Contract/Spreadsheet experience

Join a global leader in innovative medical device solutions, specializing in cardiovascular and peripheral interventional products. We are expanding our footprint in Brazil and seeking a dynamic professional to drive market penetration and excellence in customer engagement.

As the Country Sales Manager , you will lead the development and execution of sales strategies for coronary and peripheral interventional products in Brazil. Qualifications:

  1. 8+ years in medical device sales, with a focus on cardiovascular/peripheral interventional products

Regulatory Knowledge:

  1. Expertise in ANVISA processes (e.g., RDC 751/2022), MDSAP, and INMETRO/ANATEL certifications

Language Skills:

  1. Fluency in Portuguese and English (written and verbal) is mandatory

Soft Skills:

  1. Strong negotiation, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration abilities
  2. Self-motivated with a track record of independent decision-making

  • Self-sufficiency & Ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams

  • In-depth knowledge of contractual terms and conditions, risk management; experience in structuring and negotiating contracts to minimize business risk
  • Ability to think strategically and be operationally rigorous
  • Familiarity with CRMs (Salesforce)

title: Consultor(a) de Change Management
description:
Atribuições Principais
Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente em

O que procuramos?
Atribuições Principais
Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente em gestão de mudança organizacional (Change Management) para atuar nas ações do ciclo de Planejamento Estratégico de Tecnologia (TI 2030), com foco inicial nas iniciativas de evolução da resiliência digital da empresa. Esta posição exige forte capacidade de articulação com stakeholders, visão sistêmica, habilidade de comunicação com alta liderança e domínio na criação de materiais executivos e instrumentos de monitoramento do sucesso da mudança; além de experiência em cenários de transformação tecnológica (ex: adoção de DevSecOps, Agilidade, etc) em cenários de ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos digitais fim a fim.
Escopo do Programa
O programa de Resiliência Digital visa elevar a maturidade tecnológica da organização, atuando nas seguintes frentes:

  • Redução de débito técnico e obsolescência;
  • Tratamento de vulnerabilidades tecnológicas;
  • Evolução da arquitetura dos sistemas;
  • Melhorias de qualidade de software e processos de desenvolvimento;
  • Implantação e adoção de plataformas internas de desenvolvimento (IDP) com consequente evolução no modelo operacional de tecnologia;
  • Aprimoramento dos planos de continuidade de negócios.
Responsabilidades da Posição
  • Desenvolver e executar estratégias de change management para as frentes do programa.
  • Conduzir análises de impacto organizacional e mapeamento de stakeholders.
  • Elaborar e executar planos de comunicação, engajamento e capacitação para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Apoiar líderes e gestores na condução da mudança e superação de resistências.

title: Client Operations Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Client Operations Manager role at Chore

As the Operations Program Manager / Chief of Staff (Client Accounts), you’ll run back-office ops (HR, Finance, Compliance) for multiple startups—owning delivery, triaging edge cases, and building scalable processes.

About Us

Chore exists to make every startup and SMB in the world successful. We believe that the more successful startups, the better a world we’ll all experience.

Operations are foundational yet most companies chronically underinvest in them to their detriment. We build and maintain their back-office operations so that they can focus on their differentiating superpowers.

We work behind the scenes to help our clients win. We like efficiency. We geek out on checklists. We are transparent with each other and our clients. We are professional, inclusive, and autonomous and our goal is to provide a culture that fosters long-term success, is reputation & trust-based, fun, and pushes each of us to always learn.

We are looking for proactive, detail-oriented individuals interested in joining as a "Chore CEO" (what we call our operation program managers). Lead multi-workstream back-office programs (HR/Finance/Compliance) for startups; unblock teams and leaders, and deliver outcomes across a client portfolio.

You are the main conduit through which all our client's back-office operations run. You are their project manager and leader. You are the person they trust to keep things running so they can focus on their product and sales.

A Chore CEO serves as a fractional Chief of Staff/Chief Operating Officer — working with multiple startup founders / CEOs to project manage key corporate matters. These responsibilities are often tactical, but as you build trusted relationships with the CEOs of these world-changing startups, you will also become their strategic partner. In short, you are the unsung hero and critical foundation to their startup. Successful project manager operations leads get it done, figure it out, proactively get ahead of problems, and communicate every step.

Some examples of the work we do

  • The operations team is sometimes the dumping ground for things that don't go anywhere else. While others are bothered by that, we revel in it. We get it done when no one else can.
  • Use judgment and thoughtfulness — “can you work with our accountant to get taxes filed?” or “can you get this NDA out to a customer and coordinate if there are any issues?”
  • Research and problem-solving for back-office edge cases.
  • Be smart enough and skilled enough to jump from a finance question to an HR question to a vendor question.
  • We handle the complex unknowns.
  • Strategic work — e.g., “how should I think about compensation and benchmarks for my company?” We’ve seen this organically happen at times when OPs have built a trusted relationship with clients.

Qualifications/Skills

  • 5+ years of startup business experience that includes interfacing with clients or external parties is required.
  • 2+ years experience in at least two of the following: Project management, Product management, Customer Success, Client Operations, HR, Finance, Legal/Law/Attorney, or Compliance.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and excellent ability to context switch.
  • Great communication skills: this includes not only an ability to talk on a call but much more so, write down every step and communicate the value of that step, effectively.
  • Ability to say "no" in a way that doesn’t feel like a "no" to the other party.
  • You love building deep, trusting relationships with dynamic founders across many industries.
  • Are a total geek for better processes, more standardization, and reinventing things just enough to make them more efficient. You enjoy improving every day. You know what Kaizen means and the fact we care about it excites you.
  • Checking items off of your work list, while also considering ‘how can I do this process more efficiently,’ brings a smile to your face. There is always more to do for clients and you thrive on getting things done while simultaneously knowing that you are helping to move these amazing startups forward.
  • People who have a deep dedication to client service and doing right by our stakeholders.
  • Seeing delight on a client's face brings delight to your day.
  • Ability to focus in stressful situations and almost automatically prioritize.
  • Openness to giving and receiving feedback.
  • You don't mind doing the unsexy part of running a startup - i.e. dealing with regulators (including waiting on hold forever for them to pick up), managing employee offboarding, and basically doing the "startup plumber" work.
  • If you believe you deserve to only work on "sexy things" then this isn’t the role for you. We live in the unsexy but critical.
  • You want to join a passionate, fun and kind team for the long-term (2+ years). While this role might be a stepping stone and we celebrate our team member’s growth, if you apply, our assumption is that you’d prefer a job where you can see yourself for several years.

Compensation

  • Base compensation, starting compensation is $40,000 USD per year but we expect most teammates, once ramped and with bonus, will earn around $52,000 USD or more per year.
  • Every team member receives equity in Chore, which is variable based on level. Since we're building for the long-term, we offer equity on the high side.
  • Note: we do not negotiate as we believe it is biased against various groups and creates poor dynamics. Instead, we pay and promote based on performance and meeting clearly defined metrics.

The Best Parts

  • ️ We are fully remote, do not require any travel and have somewhat flexible hours! The expectation is that all Chore CEOs work standard US hours from 9-5pm.
  • We’re good people who work well together while solving critical problems for awesome startups.
  • WFH stipend up to $250/month (office setup, coffees, co-working space, etc).
  • Why is "executive" coaching only valuable for executives? We think that's stupid. Optional coaching 2x/mo.
  • Only four ~30-minute team meetings/week.
  • Support from a team of other experts and teamwork to complete your work.

Additional Notes

  • There will be five 15-60 minute interviews via Google Meet, one of which is a Q&A with another Chore CEO to vet the role for you, too!
  • To help set you up for the success, half of the questions are provided for the 1st interview
  • We will ask for up to 4 former (or current) manager references.

If you want us to consider your application, you must apply to the role via the form.

We like fun and making some magic. Join us. You'll learn more and, we expect, have more fun than any other role you've ever had.
